facts.fact: Vanguard refers to the Cybercrimes (Prevention, Prohibition, etc.) and Amendment Act of 2024 as existing; the document gives no event date, so its published date of 2025-08-01 is used.

Activist Olamide Thomas was arrested and charged under the Cybercrimes Act in December 2024 for allegedly insulting the President's son on Facebook; the article also reports police arrests of other critics, used against critics and social media users.
